items.title: [Extended 1/15/27] OnePay: $1 Cashback Per Gallon Of Gas Every Wednesday (50 Gallons, Two Redemptions Per Day)
items.why: Weekly fuel cashback is steering users onto OnePay's own cards, a useful model for gas perks tied to proprietary products.
items.summary_ai: OnePay extended its weekly Wednesday gas cashback through January 15, 2027, now requiring a OnePay debit or Builder card.
items.take: Weekly fuel cashback is steering users onto OnePay's own cards, a useful model for gas perks tied to proprietary products.
